//: A fixture, not a product: a webhook recorder (D78). One `webhook` job, `ingest`, reads a Fathom or a tl;dv delivery — the two shapes in fixtures/ — and hands it to Content.logRecordedNote under the same contract Granola's schedule job uses. Its manifest declares `ingress: { signature: 'hmac-sha256' }`, so web verifies a delivery before the worker ever sees it. The worker's recorder live test drives it through the ingress.
name: @spaces/plugin-recorder-webhook
